prompt: A designed desktop web application screen, 1536x1024, no browser chrome, no device frame: the "splice" console (a local gateway that runs one developer's coding-agent sessions on several model backends called heads), Teams page, dark theme. VISUAL SYSTEM, THE STRIP BAY: every session, head and message is a printed paper strip held in a bay, like air-traffic-control flight progress strips: a strict horizontal field grid of fixed-width boxed fields, opaque pale strip (warm off-white #ECEAE2) with black ink, a 6px colored holder edge on the strip's left (green = ok, amber = warn, red = needs attention, grey = idle), tabular monospace figures right-aligned in every field, compact grotesque labels in lowercase. Bays are darker racks with a small printed label plate on top. The room is deep graphite (#1B1D1C), bays a step darker (#151716), rails and rules hairline (#3A3D3B). No glow, no neon, no blue-black, no gradients, no rounded cards, no icons. Charts are dark scope insets (near-black panel, thin light traces). REGIONS IN ORDER: (1) a narrow left rail, 9% width, listing the pages as small bay labels: fleet, turns, sessions, teams, projects, accounts, usage, settings, models, logs, compaction, mcp, doctor; "teams" is active and carries a holder-edge tab. (2) a thin fixed rule across the top: "splice" wordmark left; "14:02:11 local  12:02:11 utc"; "daemon ok" with a small green square; "nearest window: claudex acct-a 5h 74% resets 16:40"; "3 heads report no window". (3) a team header strip under the rule: "grailseeker-backend", goal "promoter bookkeeping lives on fly raw", repo "~/Documents/dev/infra/grailseeker-backend", "3 slots, 3 bound", "lead driving: gs-backend-claude". (4) MAIN AREA, the whole width under the team header: THE DAY AS A RACK. Time runs top to bottom (13:30 at the top, now at the bottom, hairline hour marks with times on the left edge). Three column bays, one per member, labeled with the member's name, head and role on the plate: gs-backend-claude (claude, lead), gs-backend-builder (claude-deepseek, builder), gs-backend-builder2 (claude-deepseek, builder). Each column holds that member's strips stacked at their times: activity strips (small, grey edge: "editing PromoterLedger.kt", "running checks/gate.sh") and turn strips (with tokens and duration figures). Messages are strips that CROSS columns: a message strip starts in the sender's column at its time and slides into the receiver's column, drawn as a strip bridging the two columns with a thin hairline connector, the newest one (14:01, packet GS-42, lead to builder 2) caught mid-slide, angled, at the bottom of the rack. At the very bottom a "now" rule with the current in-flight turns as cocked strips. (5) A RIGHT COLUMN, 26% width: the team's slots as three compact strips (role, head, bound session, window), then cost per role for the day in a small ruled table (lead, builder, unattributed), then a dark scope inset with the day's turns per member as thin bars. Every strip at data density. REAL CONTENT ONLY: session names gs-backend-claude (role lead, head claude, model fable, account acct-a, 5h 74%), gs-backend-builder and gs-backend-builder2 (role builder, head claude-deepseek, model deepseek-flash, window "not reported by provider"); messages: "packet GS-41: promoter bookkeeping lives on fly raw. build, run parity, report" from the lead to builder 1 at 13:41, "GS-41 done, see ledger" from builder 1 to the lead at 13:58, "packet GS-42: dearm the machine-update schedule" from the lead to builder 2 at 14:01; activity: "editing PromoterLedger.kt", "running checks/gate.sh", "searching for fly_raw", "reading MANIFEST.toml", "messaging a peer session". EXCLUSIONS: no aircraft, radar, runway or airport imagery; no logos; no browser chrome; no prices or benchmarks; no invented company names; no lorem ipsum; no glow. A render that could hang as a poster is wrong: this is a working screen whose job (see the team, read who is driving, read the last hand-off) must be readable from the image alone.
